basic.name: 普通攻击：蹁跹
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
若普攻命中目标，招式结束后可为自身回复[浮晖]；
第四段普攻结束后可为命中的敌人施加1个[流明积蓄点]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to four attacks ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
If the Basic Attack hits the target, gains Floating Radiance after the skill ends.
After the 4th hit of the Basic Attack ends, 1 Lumiflux Buildup is applied to enemies hit.

special.name: 特殊技：薄明
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动远程攻击，造成流明属性伤害。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a ranged attack ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：曙色颂
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Ode to Dawn
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
进入战场时，若自身不足60点能量则回复至60点，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动大范围攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
招式结束后为命中的敌人施加2个[流明积蓄点]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, if Remielle has less than 60 Energy, her Energy is recovered to 60. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
After the skill ends, apply 2 Lumiflux Buildup to all enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：对影
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动强力斩击，造成流明属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：交叠舞步
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方发动多段大范围攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
发动时自身进入[映曜]状态，下次发动[普通攻击：垂虹]时会升级为[普通攻击：惊鸿]；
招式结束后为命中的敌人施加2个[流明积蓄点]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple attacks ahead in a large area, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Enters the Luminous Reflection state upon activation. The next Basic Attack: Rainbow's End is upgraded to Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.
After the skill ends, apply 2 Lumiflux Buildup to enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：缭乱终幕
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方进行大范围攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
若命中目标，招式结束后可触发[耀变]效果，倍率为220.5%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launches an attack across a large area in front, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
If the skill hits, the Luminize effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of 220.5%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：片羽新生

defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：眠醒残明

facts.text:
蕾米埃尔的[异化系数]为自身异常精通的0.02%，且当队伍中[异常]角色数量为3时，[异化系数]额外提升10%；
蕾米埃尔通过队友触发[异化]反应时，会根据此次属性异常效果在受到[异化]加强后的[异常效果强度]生成[虚曜]，最多可储存最新生成的3个[虚曜]；
若[支援技：花羽轮舞]/[终结技：缭乱终幕]/[普通攻击：垂虹]/[普通攻击：惊鸿]命中目标，在招式结束后可触发[耀变]效果：
基于已储存的所有[虚曜]中的[异常效果强度]，对敌人造成招式对应倍率的属性异常伤害，并根据自身异常精通的0.2%提升此伤害倍率；
蕾米埃尔在进入[相变时流]状态时或发动[普通攻击：垂虹]或[普通攻击：惊鸿]后，会清空身上储存的所有[虚曜]。
facts.textEn:
Remielle's Refringe Coefficient is equal to 0.02% of her Anomaly Proficiency. If there are 3 Anomaly characters in the squad, her Refringe Coefficient increases by an additional 10%.
When Remielle triggers a Refringe reaction through a teammate, she generates Voidflare based on the enhanced Anomaly Effect Strength of the current Attribute Anomaly after it has been Refringed. Up to the 3 most recently generated Voidflares can be stored.
If Assist: Flower & Feather Dance, Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call, Basic Attack: Rainbow's End, or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace hits a target, Luminize is triggered after the skill ends：
Based on the Anomaly Effect Strength of all stored Voidflares, deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to the enemy using the corresponding skill's DMG multiplier. This multiplier is further increased by 0.2% of Remielle's Anomaly Proficiency.
All stored Voidflares are cleared when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state or after using Basic Attack: Rainbow's End or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.

cinema.name: 青涩誓言
cinema.description: 进入战场时，蕾米埃尔获得3个特殊[虚曜]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；蕾米埃尔触发[耀变]效果造成伤害时，无视目标50%的全属性伤害抗性；发动[支援技：花羽轮舞]时，获得200点喧响值，18秒内最多触发1次此效果；蕾米埃尔处于[相变时流]状态下时，队伍中其他角色造成的属性异常伤害提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflares. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Remielle triggers Luminize to deal DMG, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When using Assist: Flower & Feather Dance, she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s. While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, other squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10%.

cinema.name: 倾落喧嚣
cinema.description: 蕾米埃尔的[异化系数]提升20%；队伍中[异常]角色对[幻色]效果下的敌人造成属性异常伤害时，无视目标15%的防御力，[幻色]效果消失后该效果会额外持续8秒；蕾米埃尔在[相变时流]状态下自主发动攻击为敌人施加[流明积蓄点]的频率提升。
cinema.descriptionEn: Remielle's Refringe Coefficient increases by 20%. When an Anomaly character in the squad deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy affected by Prismatic, the attack ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after Prismatic ends. While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, the frequency at which she automatically attacks to apply Lumiflux Buildup to enemies increases.

cinema.name: 时间分岔的花园
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 漫长的告别
cinema.description: 蕾米埃尔触发[耀变]效果时，伤害倍率额外提升12%；在蕾米埃尔进入战场获得3个特殊[虚曜]后，若将[虚曜]全部消耗，则可再一次获得最大数量的特殊[虚曜]，可再次获得特殊[虚曜]的效果在生效1次后或蕾米埃尔进入[相变时流]状态时消失。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Remielle triggers Luminize, the DMG multiplier is increased by an additional 12%. After entering the battlefield and gaining 3 special Voidflares, if all Voidflares are consumed, she immediately gains the maximum number of special Voidflares again. This effect to regain special Voidflares is removed after being triggered once or when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state.

cinema.name: 归客痛饮遗忘
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2

cinema.name: 千度振翅的孑羽
cinema.description: 蕾米埃尔发动[普通攻击：垂虹]和[普通攻击：惊鸿]时，会触发2次[耀变]效果；若第四段[普通攻击]命中目标，招式结束后蕾米埃尔可获得3个特殊[虚曜]，通过此种方式获得的特殊[虚曜]可造成的伤害为进入战场时获得的特殊[虚曜]的25%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Remielle uses Basic Attack: Rainbow's End or Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace, Luminize is triggered 2 times. If the 4th hit of her Basic Attack lands against a target, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflares after the skill ends. Special Voidflares gained this way deal DMG equal to 25% of the special Voidflares gained upon entering the battlefield.

向前方发动大范围攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
招式结束后为命中的敌人施加2个[流明积蓄点]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, if Remielle has less than 60 Energy, her Energy is recovered to 60. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
After the skill ends, apply 2 Lumiflux Buildup to all enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 特殊技：曙色颂·转辉
ex.nameEn: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn
ex.description:
若蕾米埃尔处于接战状态中且[浮晖]达到最大值120点时，在[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]后长按 【特殊技键】 可进入[转换姿态]，在[转换姿态]下切换角色时，蕾米埃尔会进入[相变时流]状态：
[相变时流]状态下蕾米埃尔会自主行动，协助作战，其中部分攻击还可为目标施加[流明积蓄点]，期间[浮晖]会随时间消耗，当[浮晖]耗尽或离开接战状态时会退出[相变时流]状态，未退出[相变时流]状态前，蕾米埃尔无法通过[连携技]之外的方式主动换入；
若蕾米埃尔在一次[相变时流]状态下触发3次[异化]反应后，或在[浮晖]耗尽时自身储存的[虚曜]数量大于等于1时，则激活[支援技：花羽轮舞]，解锁普通换入并使蕾米埃尔下次普通换入时自动发动[支援技：花羽轮舞]；
进入[相变时流]状态时，蕾米埃尔会使全队角色造成的伤害提升1.5%，持续60秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
若蕾米埃尔发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]攻击命中处于失衡状态的敌人，且[浮晖]达到最大值120点时，在[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]中切换角色也可进入[相变时流]状态；
若进入[转换姿态]后未切换角色，则蕾米埃尔发动下落攻击回到地面。
ex.descriptionEn:
When Remielle is in combat and her Floating Radiance reaches its maximum of 120, hold [Special Attack] after a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to enter Stance Shift. Switching characters while in Stance Shift causes Remielle to enter the Phase Flow state:
While in the Phase Flow state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. In this state, Floating Radiance is consumed over time, and some of her attacks apply Lumiflux Buildup to the target. When Floating Radiance is fully depleted or upon leaving combat, Remielle exits the Phase Flow state. Before exiting the Phase Flow state, Remielle cannot be actively switched in except via a Chain Attack.
If Remielle triggers 3 Refringe reactions in one Phase Flow state, or has at least 1 stored Voidflare when Floating Radiance is fully depleted, Assist: Flower & Feather Dance becomes available, and her normal switch-in is unlocked. Assist: Flower & Feather Dance is automatically used on Remielle's next normal switch-in.
Upon entering the Phase Flow state, Remielle increases all squad members's DMG by 1.5% for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Remielle's Floating Radiance has reached its maximum of 120 and her Special Attack or EX Special Attack hits a Stunned enemy, she can also enter the Phase Flow state by switching characters during the Special Attack or EX Special Attack.
If no character is switched in after entering Stance Shift, Remielle uses a downward attack to return to the ground instead.

ultimate.name: 终结技：缭乱终幕
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方进行大范围攻击，造成流明属性伤害；
若命中目标，招式结束后可触发[耀变]效果，倍率为220.5%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launches an attack across a large area in front, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
If the skill hits, the Luminize effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of 220.5%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：片羽新生
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对目标发动斩击，造成流明属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleashes a slash at the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
